target.outcome: instantaneous COVID-19 case fatality (retrospectively attributed deaths among newly confirmed cases)
target.geography: England, Northern Ireland, Scotland, and Wales

substitutions.published: DEFRA UK-Air country daily monitor averages
substitutions.reanalysis: Open-Meteo/CAMS hourly gridded PM2.5 at country centroids, daily mean
substitutions.reason: required independent public exposure source; author-derived exposure values prohibited

substitutions.reanalysis: Open-Meteo archive hourly gridded temperature, RH, sunshine at country centroids
substitutions.reason: independent public covariates needed for adjusted reconstruction

substitutions.published: backprojNP using gamma confirmation-to-death delay (mean 7.92; distribution shape not reported)
substitutions.reason: insufficient published delay-distribution parameterization to recreate backprojection

substitutions.published: binomial GLMM with DLNM cross-basis spline terms and country random effects
substitutions.reanalysis: binomial-logit GLM with country fixed effects, weekday, RH and lag-window means
substitutions.reason: closest fully executable model after the stated outcome/exposure substitution; exact spline specification and random-effects implementation unavailable

coverage.notes: 510 country-days retained after required lags, 2.5--97.5% predictor trimming, positive cases, and attributed deaths <= cases.

effect.contrast: per 1 ug/m3 increase in mean PM2.5 across confirmation-day through 10 days before confirmation
